problems.prompt: A pair of bullocks exerts a force of 140 N on a plough. The field being ploughed is 15 m long. How much work is done in ploughing the length of the field?
problems.attempt_hint: Work = Force x Displacement hota hai. Sidha formula lagao.

solution_steps.narration: Force aur displacement same direction mein hain, directly multiply karte hain.
Values put karke final result nikal lo.

problems.prompt: Calculate the work required to be done to stop a car of 1500 kg moving at a velocity of 60 km/h.
problems.attempt_hint: Car rokni hai matlab final kinetic energy zero karni hai. Work-energy theorem apply karo.

solution_steps.narration: Velocity ko km/h se m/s mein badalna padega.
Work-energy theorem ke hisab se, Work done is the change in Kinetic energy.

problems.prompt: A bag of wheat weighs 200 kg. To what height should it be raised so that its potential energy may be 9800 J? (g = 9.8 m/s^2)
problems.attempt_hint: Potential energy ka formula E_p = mgh lagao aur height nikal lo.

solution_steps.narration: Potential energy mgh ke barabar hoti hai.
Saari given values equation mein daalo.
h nikalne ke liye divide karo.

problems.prompt: Find the energy in kWh consumed in 10 hours by four devices of power 500 W each.
problems.attempt_hint: Pehle charo devices ki total power nikalo kilowatts mein, fir time in hours se multiply kar do.

solution_steps.narration: Total power watts mein nikalo aur kilowatt mein change karo.
Energy = Power x Time (kW aur hour mein).

problems.prompt: An object of mass m is moving with a constant velocity v. How much work should be done on the object in order to bring the object to rest?
problems.attempt_hint: Work-energy theorem use karo: Work done is equal to change in kinetic energy.

solution_steps.narration: Final kinetic energy nikalte hain. Body ruk gayi, to velocity zero ho gayi.
Initial kinetic energy motion ki wajah se hai.
Work done change in KE hota hai (Final - Initial).

problems.prompt: Calculate the power of a pump which can lift 100 kg of water to store it in a water tank at a height of 19 m in 25 seconds. (Take g = 10 m/s^2)
problems.attempt_hint: Pump ne kitna kaam kiya ye (mgh) nikalo aur use time se divide kar do.

solution_steps.narration: Work done against gravity mgh hota hai.
Power hoti hai work done per unit time.
Divide karke watts mein answer likho.
